newsitem.title: EGYPT: Eight killed in bus-armoured vehicle collision.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed in bus-armoured vehicle collision.

text.p: Eight people were killed and 18 wounded when a public bus collided with a police armoured vehicle in southern Egypt on Thursday, security sources said.
Police Lieutenant Wa'el Salah Hussein was killed in the vehicle. The other seven were from the bus, including the driver, controller and inspector.
"Most of the wounded are in critical condition," the sources added. The public bus was on its way from Cairo to Assiut, 320 km (200 miles), to the south.
